text:
Noah: quick thought - can we surface a tiny "paused-at" badge on the timeline gutter instead of changing variant chips? mock: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/pause-gutter

Marta: I like low-noise badges. keeps variant rows clean. how do we show reason? tooltip on hover with timestamp and actor?

Keiko: tooltip + small pill in inspector when focused. on mobile the tooltip becomes a bottom-sheet with the same info.

Alex (A11y): ensure badge is focusable (tabindex=0), provide aria-describedby linking to detailed reason. SR announcement: "Rollout paused at 14% by Keiko, reason: automated guardrail".

Noah: copy for badge: "Paused @14%" or just a dot with alt-text? prefer short visible text to avoid confusion.

Marta: "Paused @14%" is clear. use amber for pause, not red. also add an optional small clock icon when pause is time-limited (auto-resume).

Keiko: confirm flow: clicking badge opens inspector with 'Resume' primary and 'View reason' secondary. Resume should be immediate with undo toast. Pause requires confirmation modal.

Alex (A11y): modal checklist as usual: focus trap, role=dialog, descriptive text, and announce actionable outcome. For the toast undo, ensure keyboard focus isn't stolen; make undo reachable via keyboard and SR reads toast content.

Noah: deploy-bot preview when updated?

deploy-bot: preview created for feat/pause-gutter -> https://preview.redwood.dev/pause-gutter (expires in 24h)

Marta: will update figma and run contrast checks. thanks all :thumbsup:
